verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduling recurring jobs: 'Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits, or syncing docs after PRs merge,' and the web/app UI lets you 'schedule recurring tasks.' Additionally, 'Routines' can be configured once to run on a schedule, API call, or event trigger, and MCP servers can push events (webhooks, Telegram, Discord) into a session while away. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the scheduling UI in practice and more detail on reliability/monitoring of scheduled jobs.
